steps.caption: Posts & photos
steps.narration: This is Posts and Photos. Write Google updates, add job photos, and schedule them to publish to your Google Business Profile.

steps.caption: Choose a linked location
steps.narration: Start by choosing a location that is linked to its Google listing.

steps.caption: Photos and media library
steps.narration: Photos and media library takes up to one hundred job photos at a time, filed by Google photo category.

steps.caption: Tick the photos to use
steps.narration: Tick the photos you want. A long file name is shortened to fit.

steps.caption: AI drafts and style
steps.narration: AI drafts and style: give instructions or example wording, and the AI drafts captions and posts for you.

steps.caption: Saved style guidance
steps.narration: Saved style guidance keeps the drafts friendly, plain-spoken and local.

steps.caption: Compose a Google update
steps.narration: Compose a Google update: a standard update, an event or an offer.

steps.value: Fall gutter clean-outs are booking now. Call for a free inspection.
steps.caption: Write the update
steps.narration: Type the update, or generate a draft above and edit it.

steps.caption: Add a button
steps.narration: Add a button like Book, Call or Learn more.

steps.caption: Schedule and approve
steps.narration: Pick the first publish time, how many per day or per week, and business hours if you like.

steps.caption: Approve & queue post
steps.narration: Nothing publishes until you approve it. Choose Approve and queue post.

steps.caption: New post at the top of the queue
steps.narration: The approved post lands at the top of Calendar, queue and history.

steps.caption: Cancel, retry, refresh status
steps.narration: Every item shows its time and status. Cancel anything still queued, retry a failure, or refresh the Google status.

steps.caption: Photos and words in, published on schedule
steps.narration: Photos and words in, approved by you, published on your schedule.

steps.caption: Menu: Posts & Photos
steps.narration: You'll find Posts and Photos in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.title: Google Posts & Photos in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Posts & Photos in ConstructHUB: upload job photos by Google category, write Google updates or draft them with AI in your own style, approve them, and let the schedule publish them to your Google Business Profile at the pace you set. The calendar shows every item's status at Google.
